chunks: And 'Asim ibn Humayd narrated from Muhammad ibn Qays, who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far عليه السلام say: "A Jew and a Christian do not inherit from Muslims, while Muslims inherit from the Jew and the Christian."

key_terms.النَّصْرَانِيُّ: a Christian, mentioned here in the context of inheritance law
key_terms.الْمُسْلِمُونَ: Muslims, as legal heirs in this ruling
key_terms.الْيَهُودِيُّ: a Jew, mentioned here in the context of inheritance law
key_terms.يَرِثُ: to inherit legally from a deceased person's estate

ai.seo_question: Can a Jew or a Christian inherit from a Muslim according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling on inheritance between Muslims and non-Muslims from among Jews and Christians. It establishes that a Jew or Christian does not inherit from Muslims, whereas Muslims may inherit from Jews and Christians.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5727 - Asim ibn Humaid narrated from Muhammad ibn Qays who said:
I heard Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) say: "A Jew and a Christian do not inherit from Muslims, but Muslims inherit from Jews and Christians."
